question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 27, 69, 15, 88, 15, 54, 53, 20 and 19 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the Net Deviation Method, let us assume the average is 40.

Deviations from 40: −13, +29, −25, +48, −25, +14, +13, −20, −21.

Sum of positive deviations = 29 + 48 + 14 + 13 = +104.

Sum of negative deviations = −13 − 25 − 25 − 20 − 21 = −104.

Net deviation = 104 − 104 = 0, meaning our assumed average is exactly correct.

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 27, 69, 15, 88, 15, 54, 53, 20, 19

Total number of observations (n) = 9

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations
